description: Utah legalized medical cannabis because patients fought to be treated like patients. We should never allow the system built from that victory to drift backward into treating them like suspects, revenue sources, or problems for regulators to manage.I was directly involved in drafting Proposition 2 and the Utah Medical Cannabis Act that followed. title: Medical cannabis, patient dignity, and regulatory accountability
